about: Baseline for scripts/mm2-watch.mjs, built from the free-items research (murder-mystery-2.free-items.json, watch_sources) and the same endpoints read on 2026-10-05. A difference means MM2 or its wiki changed: re-check the free-items guide, codes, boxes and events seeds, then refresh this file with `node scripts/mm2-watch.mjs --update`.
